messages:
alex: Quick question — the rollout dashboard currently shows canary vs baseline lines but no automatic traffic-split guard. Can we add a widget that flags when canary p95 latency > baseline p95 by X% for N minutes?

maria: Agree, been hitting this. We need both an alert and a visible 'traffic hold' button in the UI. Small threshold + hysteresis to avoid flapping.

sam: For hysteresis, suggest 10% for 5 minutes to trigger, 3 consecutive datapoints to clear. Works well with our 1m scraping cadence.

tay: @sam can you sketch the query? I'm thinking promql with rollout_id label so we can slice by deployment.
sam: Sure, something like: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{rollout_id=~"$rollout"}[5m])) by (le))` then compare to baseline where `variant="baseline"` vs `variant="canary"`. Then alert if `(canary / baseline) > 1.10` for 5m.

alex: Nice. We should also handle small sample sizes — if canary RPS < 50 during window, suppress the alert and mark as low-sample.

maria: +1. Also add a quick drilldown link from the alert to the request traces and the per-route table (so PMs can see which endpoints regressed).

ana_pm: From product side: make the default traffic split UI show safe defaults: 5% for first 10 min, auto-increase to 20% after health checks, and stop if guard fires. Need ability to override.

sre-ops: We will need a fallback policy for capacity limits — if canary autoscale fails, the UI should show 'capacity hold' separate from metric guards.

tay: Implementation notes: UI needs a small state machine for rollout status: ORPHAN -> STARTED -> HEALTHY -> PAUSED (metric guard) -> FROZEN (manual). Each state drives available actions.

sam: Telemetry: emit `rollout_evaluation_total{rollout_id="$rollout",variant="canary",result="regressed"}` with labels for `error_reason` and `sample_size`. Also emit `rollout_traffic_change{rollout_id,from_percent,to_percent}` every decision.

alex: Also want a per-route heatmap: rows = routes, cols = metrics (p95, error-rate, latency-trend). Color by delta(canary, baseline). Click a cell to open traces and recent logs filter.

maria: For alerts, add alert severity mapping: minor for 10-20% p95 regressions, major for >20% or if error-rate increases. Pager only for major + sustained >10m.

ana_pm: UX ask: designers want a tiny inline explainer for what 'hysteresis' means and a 'why did rollout pause' bullet list pulled from telemetry.

sre-ops: On the backend, we'll add a guard-eval worker that samples metrics and computes guards, then writes decisions to `rollout_state` table. UI polls or listens via websocket.

tay: Edge-case: multi-variant A/B (canary + alt1 + alt2). Guard should consider pairwise comparisons to baseline, but also detect when a single variant wins and auto-shrink losers. Need product approval.

ana_pm: Approve the basic multi-variant logic: flag any variant with p95 > baseline by threshold. Auto-shrink to 0% for variants that fail three evaluations.

alex: I'll open a short RFC and a simplified mock for the dashboard. Can someone owner the metrics query unit tests?

sam: I'll add tests and a fake prometheus in CI to simulate low-sample and regressed scenarios.

deploy-bot: deploy started for rollout 20260304-57
sre-ops: deployed canary at 5%

alex: Let's land the dashboard change behind a feature flag `rollout_dashboard_v2`.

maria: Thx. Small follow-up: export a CSV of the per-route deltas for postmortem analysis.

ana_pm: Thanks all, big win for reducing noisy rollouts.

sam: I'll post PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1224
